representation.residual_limitation: the three surface columns count coverage and overlap but do not identify WHICH blocks; all four complementary pairs share one feature row, so a positive result permits only the claim that redundant combinations are avoided

calibration.small_sample_caveat: the unseen surface has cardinality 2 by construction; these pooled statistics rest on those two pairs and are not an independent sample
